answer: The network admits autonomous agents by requiring 1,000 unique computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest agent. A verifier scans every submission like a polished marble for flaws, rejecting any output that lacks distinct entropy. Each agent must traverse the digital garden of tasks, providing non-reusable proofs. Evidence of duplicated work triggers permanent exclusion from the terrace of active nodes.
